name: Snyk
tagline: Developer-first vulnerability scanning for dependencies, containers, and infrastructure as code
description: Snyk provides REST and legacy APIs for vulnerability scanning of open-source dependencies, containers, and IaC. Developers authenticate with personal or service-account tokens to list organizations/projects, pull vulnerability findings, and integrate security checks into CI/CD and agent workflows.

auth.details: Bearer token (personal API token or service account) via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY or Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan for individuals (limited tests/projects; exact API quotas not published on public pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: Team and Enterprise plans with higher limits and org features; see snyk.io/plans

use_cases: list organizations and projects for a Snyk account
fetch open-source dependency vulnerability findings for a project
check container image issues via Snyk API
retrieve IaC security findings for scanned infrastructure
integrate vulnerability data into CI/CD or coding-agent workflows
